title: Security schemes endpoint returns empty array despite API requiring authentication
description: The security schemes endpoint returns an empty array for the test API, even though the API requires X-API-Key authentication according to the task instructions. This makes it difficult for agents to discover authentication requirements programmatically.
reproduction_steps: Query the test API details: jentic apis inspect jentic-test/test-api/1.0.0
Check security schemes via API or CLI
Observe empty array despite API requiring authentication
expected_behavior: Security schemes endpoint should return the authentication requirements (X-API-Key) for the test API.
actual_behavior: Security schemes endpoint returns an empty array, providing no information about authentication requirements.
evidence: Security schemes endpoint returned empty array despite API requiring X-API-Key authentication per instructions
Agent narration: 'Security schemes are empty, though the instructions mentioned the API requires `X-API-Key`'
